title: Managing Context and Communication in Distributed Agentic UAV Swarms
abstract: arXiv:2610.01569v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms increasingly rely on language-model agents to provide adaptive mission-level reasoning in uncertain environments. Fully distributed control, in which each UAV hosts an independent Small Language Model (SLM), removes reliance on a centralized coordinator but introduces an information-management problem: long-running interaction histories can degrade the reasoning context, while indiscriminate information dissemination increases communication and inference overhead. We address these challenges with a distributed UAV-agent architecture that enables continuous local SLM control through an event-driven reason-act-observe lifecycle. Runtime knowledge is represented as structured atomic notes and organized into core, local, and peer-specific memory. translated_title: 分布式智能体无人机集群中的上下文与通信管理
translated_abstract: 无人机集群日益依赖语言模型智能体，以在不确定环境中提供自适应的任务级推理能力。在完全分布式控制中，每架无人机搭载一个独立的小型语言模型（SLM），这消除了对集中式协调器的依赖，但引入了信息管理问题：长期运行的交互历史会降低推理上下文的质量，而不加选择的信息传播则会增加通信与推理开销。我们通过一种分布式无人机-智能体架构来应对这些挑战，该架构通过事件驱动的“推理-行动-观察”生命周期实现持续的本地SLM控制。运行时知识被表示为结构化的原子笔记，并组织为核心记忆、本地记忆和特定对等节点记忆。一个确定性的兴趣感知gossip引擎根据接收方特定的语义新颖性和时效性，选择性地传播这些笔记。我们对……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种分布式无人机智能体架构，通过事件驱动的“推理-行动-观察”生命周期、结构化原子笔记的分层记忆组织，以及基于语义新颖性和时效性的兴趣感知gossip选择性传播机制，解决了每架无人机搭载独立小语言模型时的上下文退化与通信开销问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a distributed UAV-agent architecture that tackles context degradation and communication overhead in fully distributed UAV swarms with local SLMs, combining an event-driven reason-act-observe lifecycle, structured atomic notes organized into layered memory, and a deterministic interest-aware gossip engine for selective, recipient-specific information dissemination.
